source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL but expands MODS as 'Memory On Demand System' without source support.
source_snapshot.v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE with MODS configuration and memory baseline.

original_test_intent.statement: Run the owner-defined WAT `MODS_I MODS` scenario for 250 cycles and verify platform health.
unknowns: What MODS does, target GPUs/components, reboot behavior, parameters and pass codes.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It inherits an unsupported expansion and calls the workload memory diagnostics before private package semantics are available.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Do not expand or reinterpret MODS; require signed WAT/MODS scenario documentation, targets and result codes before the long campaign.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run 250 Cycles of the Approved WAT MODS Scenario
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the exact owner-defined `MODS_I MODS` workflow for 250 cycles and assess its specified diagnostic and platform-health results without inferring the acronym's function.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Pinned, licensed/authorized WAT and MODS packages for the exact platform.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Only components and operations defined by the signed scenario; no assumed host-memory or GPU scope.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Package hashes/licenses/provenance, token semantics, target map, MODS parameters/results, cycle/boot/timeouts, secret path, health thresholds, recovery and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Inspect package help/config, then after approval run the exact command with protected secrets and capture all 250 per-cycle WAT/MODS results and platform deltas.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Dedicated window, OOB, compatible packages and evidence capacity for 2400 minutes.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed scenario definition; package versions/hashes; exact redacted invocation; per-cycle result codes/output/timestamps; target telemetry; host/BMC/SEL health and recovery.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Only vendor/owner MODS result codes plus complete 250-cycle health policy.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not invent acronym/target, use unlicensed package, expose secrets, clear logs, hide retry or execute unknown state changes.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Tool/platform owner approves packages, scenario and disruptive window.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent may run verified harness; proprietary meaning and disposition remain engineering decisions.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Abort, preserve outputs/target state and recover through approved OOB path.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unknown semantics, package mismatch, failed result code, boot/device/thermal/power fault or evidence loss.

reason_for_change: The private scenario tokens are exact, but assigning them an invented memory-only meaning can make the agent monitor the wrong hardware and misjudge completion.
removed_ambiguities: No expansion of MODS is asserted.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 preserves the executable token sequence while removing an unsupported workload interpretation and tying all target/evidence semantics to authenticated package documentation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 89 provides exact `MODS_I MODS` tokens but no definition beyond WAT with Mods.
